note: V90Modulator::progress (780 bytes at 0x1a820) and V90Modulator::initiateRRN (308 bytes at 0x1a2c0), against t_v90modprog.  ONE SUITE REACHES ONE SOURCE FILE: tools/mutate.py takes a single `source` from suites.json -- the manifest loader refuses an entry that is not exactly [source, binary] and the runner reads that one file -- so the other three members of V90Modem::progress's closure (V90BitsToSymbol::process(unsigned char *, unsigned int &, short *), V90Modem::progress and V90Phase4Modulator::generateSymbol) live in three other files and would each need a suite of their own pointed at this same binary, which is what t_v90modchain already has five of.  All three are DRIVEN by t_v90modprog and counted in its denominators; they are simply not mutated here.

NOT here: making V90Modulator::state unsigned.  That is a change to include/dsplib/V90Modulator.h and not to this file, and the object's `cmp $0x1 ; je ; jle` at 0x1a848 is the whole evidence for the signedness -- a behavioural test sees it only through a negative state, which t_v90modprog drives, and a mutation of the DECLARATION belongs to whichever suite owns that header.
